facts: Current broad weak-neutral targeting did not improve mean score.
Vanguard's audited poor game rarely encountered eligible camps.
Neutral kills do not guarantee the killer receives neutral XP.
Arcanist's audited full-health retreat was triggered by shopping, not low mana or a missed visible creep.
Tiny favorable class slices are discovery evidence, not confirmation.
belief.uncertainty: Static camp geometry is public; hidden life, future danger, enemy intent and respawn state are unknown.

goal.Score: Maximize expected individual floor(max(0, XP - 200 * elapsed_minutes)).

bounded_camp_access.proposal: For low-income heroes lacking productive lane opportunities, choose a nearby reachable low-risk camp route with a travel budget, health/kit guard, destination reconsideration and early abandonment when a better visible wave/hero opportunity appears.
bounded_camp_access.measure: Own eligible neutral XP plus changes in lane/hero income, time cost and final score.
bounded_camp_access.falsifier: Travel, leash resets, camping near respawn or lost wave income outweigh neutral receipts.

credit_aware_finish.proposal: Maintain living same-floor six-tile eligibility around feasible neutral/creep deaths without overriding urgent survival.
credit_aware_finish.measure: Actual reward recipients and net score, not kills alone.
credit_aware_finish.falsifier: Movement to claim XP costs more income or exposes the hero to lethal damage.

caster_restore_and_shop.proposal: Coordinate useful early mana-restoration unlock/casting with an affordable class-specific upgrade basket and bounded wave-aware shopping deferral.
caster_restore_and_shop.measure: Mana-restoration effects, time to useful upgrades, XP gaps and final score in natural caster contexts.
caster_restore_and_shop.falsifier: Deferral loses item power or survival, or mana use prevents needed spells.

class_specific_return_core.proposal: Test melee/caster-appropriate core readiness together with buyback and productive return timing; the inherited controller requires the same four ranged-core items for all heroes.
class_specific_return_core.measure: Time to core, gold allocation, productive field time and score.
class_specific_return_core.falsifier: Faster returns or extra buybacks spend gold without enough XP.

lich_scoped_neutral_transfer.proposal: Independently test the direct-neutral branch only for Lich, preserving other classes, after the exploratory four-pair gain.
lich_scoped_neutral_transfer.measure: Fresh matched Lich score and broader unchanged-controller checks.
lich_scoped_neutral_transfer.falsifier: Gain disappears on new rosters/seeds or is explained by lost income elsewhere.

carry_reference_transfer.proposal: Discriminate which prior-policy routing/targeting choices explain the old Ranger gain; test one coordinated transfer on fresh carry contexts.
carry_reference_transfer.measure: Current-engine individual score with source/seed/roster/seat identity.
carry_reference_transfer.falsifier: Gain was context-specific or the transfer harms expected score.

strategy.when: low-income hero lacks productive lane opportunities
a feasible death may award XP outside current eligibility
caster income is limited by restoration or shopping timing
inherited ranged core delays a useful melee/caster return
fresh carry contexts can discriminate older behavior

execution.validation: IR-first coordinated edit; current-engine mechanics/runtime checks; frozen responsive paired hosted comparison; fresh confirmation before promotion.

update.note: Migration records hypotheses, not implemented improvements.
